title: Sun Yat-sen's birth chart
metaDescription: Sun Yat-sen's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 19.8° Scorpio. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: 0.1° separates Mercury and Mars from an exact trine; at that range thinking and drive read as one mechanism. A trine runs downhill — the talent that never announces itself because it never had to.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: The Sun's position resolves to 19.8° Scorpio — deep enough in the second decan (10°–20°) that Jupiter, its traditional sub-ruler, colours the reading.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Mercury holds 19.4° Scorpio, Venus holds 13.7° Libra, Mars holds 19.5° Pisces — in the old shorthand, thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction that begins as conversation; effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than Mercury and Mars: 0.1° from an exact trine. A third of the circle is the tradition’s friendliest distance — same element, shared assumptions, no translation required. Behind it, the Sun trine Mars at 0.3°, and the Sun conjunction Mercury at 0.4° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The dignity table, which predates the outer planets and only ever spoke for seven, marks two placements here. Venus in Libra at 13.7° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Jupiter in Virgo at 25.8° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. Dignity is a statement about conditions, not about worth.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Tallied where the signs are certain — 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day — the chart gives water 5, earth 2, fire 2, air 1, and mutable 5, fixed 4, cardinal 1 across the modes. Water weights a chart toward the felt and the remembered — information that arrives as atmosphere before it arrives as words. Every other body stayed direct. Uranus changed direction during the day, so its motion is left open.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.1° between midnight and midnight. That is quick enough to make the exact degree a neighbourhood rather than an address, and slow enough to leave the sign settled. At the noon reference it stands at 7.1°.
